name: BehaviorVerification
summary: Verifies by checking the calls the system under test made to something else, so that an effect leaving no state behind can still be asserted.

roles.name: BehaviorVerification
roles.summary: A test that checks what the system did rather than what it holds. It is the only way to verify an indirect output — a message sent, a notification raised — and it is bought with coupling to the collaboration: a refactoring that changes how the work is delegated breaks it even when the outcome is unchanged.
